intro: Meta's stock fell nearly 9% after missing revenue forecasts and reporting a 91% plunge in free cash flow, while Microsoft gained 8% on strong Azure and Copilot growth, signaling divergent trajectories in Big Tech's AI investments. Musk's xAI is challenging Minnesota's new law banning AI-generated nude images, arguing the first-in-the-nation regulation is overly broad and faces $500,000-per-violation penalties starting Saturday. OpenAI cut prices on two GPT models as companies grow more cost-conscious, while LinkedIn introduced a button to flag posts as "AI slop" amid broader industry shifts toward browser agents and away from AI search.
